title: The Blanket on the Ferry Bench
youtube_title: The Blanket on the Ferry Bench | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Delia sees that a folded blanket on the ferry bench will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Delia makes a smaller, even share so Ilaria is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
